ten: Quá khứ (động từ bất quy tắc)
script_nghe: Tell me about your trip. … We went to Nepal. … When was that? … In 2019, just before everything closed. … How long were you there? … Three weeks. … Did you buy anything? … Yes, I bought a carpet — it’s still in my living room. … And the best part? … The mountains, without question. I’d never seen anything like them.

phan.noi_dung:
> **The woman who mapped the ocean floor**
> 
> In the 1950s, most scientists believed the bottom of the ocean was flat and featureless. Marie Tharp, a geologist working in New York, thought otherwise. She was not allowed on research ships at the time because women were considered unlucky at sea, so she stayed in the office and drew maps from the data her colleagues brought back.
> 
> As she worked, she saw a deep valley running down the middle of the Atlantic. She told her colleague, who called the idea “girl talk” and dismissed it. Tharp redrew the maps three times to check. Eventually the evidence became impossible to ignore, and her discovery helped prove the theory of continental drift. She received little public recognition until the final years of her life.

**Multiple choice (6–8):**

1. Marie Tharp did not go on research ships because
   A. she preferred office work B. women were not allowed at the time C. she had no training
1. Her colleague’s first reaction to her discovery was to
   A. reject it B. publish it C. check the data himself
1. Tharp’s discovery supported the theory of
   A. ocean currents B. climate change C. continental drift

**Hoàn thành câu (9–11):**
9. Tharp worked as a ____________ in New York.
10. She found a deep ____________ in the middle of the Atlantic.
11. She redrew the maps ____________ times.

writing.de_tom_tat: Viết 70–80 từ về một chuyến đi đáng nhớ: đi đâu, khi nào, với ai, làm gì, cảm thấy thế nào.
writing.bai_mau: Two years ago I went to Da Lat with three friends. We took a night bus and got there early in the morning. We rode motorbikes around the lake and drank coffee at a small place on a hill. One evening it became very cold, so we bought hot soup from a street vendor and ate it outside. I felt completely relaxed. It was the best short trip I have ever taken.

cham_diem.tieu_chi: Dùng ≥6 động từ bất quy tắc đúng (3đ)

cham_diem.vi_sao: Bài không cần câu phủ định/hỏi, nhưng mọi động từ quá khứ đều ở dạng V2 đúng, không lẫn nguyên mẫu.
Đi đâu · khi nào · với ai · làm gì · cảm thấy thế nào.

dang_hoc: Nhóm động từ bất quy tắc dễ nhớ theo quy luật: drink–drank · sing–sang · swim–swam · begin–began (i → a).
Nhóm i → o: drive–drove · ride–rode · write–wrote.
“the best trip I have ever taken” — hiện tại hoàn thành với ever, cấu trúc nâng điểm ở cuối bài.

speaking.de_tom_tat: Tell me about a trip you took last year. / What did you eat there? / Would you go back? Why or why not?

cau_tra_loi.hoi: Tell me about a trip you took last year.
cau_tra_loi.mau: I went to Da Lat with a few friends. We took a night bus, which was uncomfortable but cheap. We spent three days riding around and drinking a lot of coffee.
cau_tra_loi.ghi_chu: “which was uncomfortable but cheap” — mệnh đề quan hệ, nâng điểm ngay ở câu đầu.

cau_tra_loi.mau: Mostly street food. We ate hot soup in the evenings because it got quite cold, and we tried a local dish made with rice paper.
cau_tra_loi.ghi_chu: “made with…” — mệnh đề rút gọn, cách nói gọn mà tự nhiên.

cau_tra_loi.hoi: Would you go back? Why or why not?
cau_tra_loi.mau: Definitely, but not at the weekend. It gets very crowded with tourists, so I'd go on a weekday next time.
cau_tra_loi.ghi_chu: Câu “would” thì trả lời bằng would/'d, đừng chuyển sang quá khứ.

cham_diem.vi_sao: Đủ, dùng nhiều động từ bất quy tắc.
ate /eɪt/ · rode /rəʊd/ · drank /dræŋk/ — nguyên âm đổi hẳn so với nguyên mẫu.

meo_noi: 40 động từ bất quy tắc trong unit 16 là danh sách bắt buộc thuộc. Không có cách nào ngoài học đi học lại.
Dùng tab Ôn tập để luyện — thẻ “nghe gõ lại từ” rất hiệu quả với động từ bất quy tắc.
